To monitor the Greater Spotted Eagles (Clanga clanga), 20 devices will be procured that meet the technical conditions described in the procurement. In addition to the devices, a data transmission service for at least 5 years will also be procured for these devices, and these two parts must be compatible, i.e. the data transmission is compatible with the devices.
